notifications.title: FBI reportedly probes database hack
notifications.body: An apparent intrusion targeted the system US police use for warrants and background checks, CNN reports.
notifications.headline: FBI reportedly probes apparent breach of crime database

notifications.title: Son’s $1tn SK Hynix idea is shelved
notifications.body: SoftBank told The Information it is no longer actively considering the deal.
notifications.headline: SoftBank’s Son explored a $1tn SK Hynix buyout: report

notifications.title: Anthropic's $1.6 trillion debut week
notifications.body: Only 6 US companies were worth more as Anthropic finished its first week of trading, CNBC reported.
notifications.headline: Anthropic ends its first trading week worth $1.6 trillion

notifications.title: FBI and USDA reportedly hacked
notifications.body: CNN says the FBI attack targeted a system used to share warrants and missing persons information.
notifications.headline: FBI and USDA reportedly hacked in fresh government breaches

notifications.title: Amazon nears deal to buy Decart
notifications.body: The Financial Times says Amazon is close to buying the Israeli video AI startup for $7.5 billion.
notifications.headline: Amazon nears $7.5B deal to buy video AI startup Decart

notifications.title: AI-aided Navier-Stokes proof claimed
notifications.body: The pair claim to remove the outside force used in OpenAI’s proof—but a numerical certificate is missing.
notifications.headline: Buckmaster and Alpöge claim Navier-Stokes blow-up without force

notifications.title: Microsoft confirms Entra data breach
notifications.body: Attackers exploited an API flaw; Microsoft fixed the vulnerability on November 19.
notifications.headline: Microsoft says Entra breach exposed admin email addresses

notifications.title: Wonder reportedly looks to sell Grubhub
notifications.body: Wonder paid $650 million for Grubhub early last year; now the Journal says it wants to sell.
notifications.headline: Wonder reportedly looks to sell Grubhub after Amazon switch

notifications.title: Neuralink participant plays GTA 6
notifications.body: Imagining a ring-finger tap lets a Neuralink trial participant trigger commands in GTA 6.

notifications.body: Trump floated a “tremendous tax” as an alternative, without first discussing the proposal with advisers.

notifications.title: SpaceX lenders resist orbital AI plans
notifications.body: Banks backing $43 billion in SpaceX debt would view chips sent into space as lost, insiders told the FT.
notifications.headline: SpaceX lenders seek to block AI chip launches into orbit, FT says

notifications.title: Trump addresses reported FBI hack
notifications.body: A former FBI official warns the concern is whether hackers could alter information officers rely on.
notifications.headline: Trump says reported FBI crime database hack is ‘not good’

notifications.title: Maple faces 'AI god' allegations
notifications.body: Former residents say Maple records even their breathing to train an AI modeled on its leader's mind.
notifications.headline: Former Maple members allege recordings aim to train an 'AI god'

notifications.title: Cognition reportedly in funding talks
notifications.body: Bloomberg says Devin's maker is weighing a raise of $2bn or more, two months after its last round.
notifications.headline: Report: Cognition in talks to raise at $75bn valuation

notifications.title: Gallego blasts crypto’s election tactics
notifications.body: Fairshake spent $55 million trying to stop Sherrod Brown from returning to the Senate. He won anyway.
notifications.headline: Gallego says crypto is ‘f*cked’ after Democrats’ sweep

notifications.title: Cursor weighs dropping Chinese AI models
notifications.body: A House report says Cursor cites “geopolitical risk”, but has no decision or timetable for a phaseout.
notifications.headline: Cursor may drop Chinese AI models, House committees say

notifications.title: Trump sees upside in reported FBI hack
notifications.body: "Maybe we’ll learn about the voter fraud," Trump said of the reported breach.
notifications.headline: Trump says reported FBI hack may reveal 'voter fraud'

notifications.title: Cyberleek ties GTA 6 file to token goal
notifications.body: Cyberleek promises an early executable release if CYBERLEEK hits $15M; none of the files are verified.
notifications.headline: Cyberleek ties claimed GTA 6 leak to $15M token target

notifications.title: Amazon: AI agents found a zero-day
notifications.body: Amazon says the agents reached file writing in roughly 11 minutes; root access came later.
notifications.headline: Amazon says AI agents found zero-day in imaging software
